components.name: Button
components.keyInsightSeed: Square, high-contrast actions use black or white fills, 2px rules, and no radius.

components.name: Card
components.keyInsightSeed: Content cards rely on hairline or heavy grid rules rather than shadows or rounded elevation.

components.name: Input
components.keyInsightSeed: No visible form field appeared on the homepage; the reusable field follows the same square rule and restrained monochrome palette.

components.name: Badge
components.keyInsightSeed: Tags are compact monochrome labels with small type, square edges, and quiet surface contrast.

components.name: CTA Link
components.keyInsightSeed: Section exits use bold uppercase labels, a trailing arrow, and a 4px underline offset.

components.name: Navigation
components.keyInsightSeed: A 58px fixed top bar pairs a compact wordmark with dense text navigation and a square theme control.
